title: Inquest to be held into police tasering death in Burnaby
article: The B.C. Coroners Service is holding a public inquest into the death of Maurizio Angelo Facchin, who died after being tasered by a Burnaby RCMP officer more than two years ago.
The coroner said Wednesday that the inquest will be held Oct. 17 at Burnaby coroners court.
Facchin, 50, of Vancouver, died after an encounter with police at an apartment in the 6900-block of Walker Avenue in the afternoon of June 4, 2014. A conducted energy weapon was deployed by the RCMP.
Coroner Isis Van Loon and a jury will hear evidence from witnesses to determine the facts surrounding Facchin's death.
